note: Frameworks where NHS Supply Chain's own two published sources disagree about when the framework ends. Reviewed by a human and recorded here so verify.py warns rather than blocking every push, while any NEW conflict still fails the gate. Being in this file is not a resolution: the Hub must not publish an expiry date for anything listed here until the owner's pages agree. Opened 02/09/2026 after the NBE leave-behind verification pass.
rule: A framework is listed here only when the launch brief's expiry and the procurement calendar's contract go-live are more than 31 days apart in the wrong direction. A go-live a day or two before expiry is a deliberate handover and is not a conflict.
